what: L-14: the orchestrator was restarted on vm-i while an instance was still being provisioned, 2026-10-19
method: a watcher on vm-i polled the container list; as soon as the containers of a new instance existed (shop, injector and volume-keeper, state Created) it restarted vulnmart-orchestrator; the API call that was creating the instance failed with orchestrator unreachable

result.reconciler_log: reconciled: adopted 1, failed 1, destroyed 0, swept 1, errors 0
result.adopted: the one running instance (the idle-proof control instance) was taken over unchanged
result.failed_and_swept: the half-provisioned instance was marked failed and its containers were removed
result.checked_about_3_minutes_after: only the platform containers and the adopted instance were listed

note: the platform attempt created for the failed start stays in state ready with no instance; it holds no capacity
